scope: Mechanism comparison; not a new MoSE reproduction or an exhaustive novelty claim.

dynasemble.paper_code_distinction: The paper writes mean/variance features; the released code uses 1-mean/variance. A fixed textual coefficient is a scale convention, not a DEV-static action-radius constraint.

mose.boundary: No explicit return-to-DEV-Global rejection gate is defined in these inference formulations. This does not assert that outputs cannot coincide numerically with a single modality.

claim_limits: Dynamic ensembling and candidate-score features predate ADC.
Reference anchoring, bounded displacement and adjustment rejection define the studied combination; no claim that tanh, clipping, shrinkage or rejection is individually new.
Shrink-gate and Clip-g share the reference and rejection semantics; tested differences isolate action maps, and tanh-specific superiority is not supported.
MMKGC is an application setting for this general score post-processor. Observable modality coverage diagnostics are associative and never become selector inputs.
